name: mc-runtime-test
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends shellcheck && curl -sSfL "https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}/actionlint_${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}_linux_$(dpkg --print-architecture).tar.gz" | sudo tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin actionlint && sudo curl -sSfL -o /usr/local/bin/yq "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_$(dpkg --print-architecture)" && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq && actionlint --version && shellcheck --version && yq --version && java -version
